rulings.ruling: Ruling: interface gap; f1099div (2025) Instructions for Recipient describes the dividend boxes, but defines no quantity named div.screen. The reply explicitly invents a total of special amounts because the required export has no supplied semantic contract. The project uses this internal adapter as zero after scope checks, including when unsupported Form4797/K-1 amounts are absent; that behavior was not independently inferable from the id/type alone. No whole-tree equivalence or clean model-only error is claimed. BUG-0135/T-064 keeps this source-interface review pending until adapter and source-defined quantities are separated.
